description: Redesign the Projects list page (ProjectsPage.tsx) and Create Project Wizard (CreateProjectWizardPage.tsx) with modern UI/UX best practices while keeping the existing Sentinel design system theme. Improvements include: better visual hierarchy, enhanced card layout with micro-interactions, improved empty states, better filter UX with search-as-you-type, and a more polished create wizard with progressive disclosure.
steps: Redesign src/pages/workspaces/ProjectsPage.tsx with the following modern UI improvements: (a) Replace the existing PageHero with a more compact, information-dense header that includes a quick-stats summary row integrated into the header area rather than as a separate HeroFacts component. (b) Improve the ProjectCard component with better visual density - add a small activity sparkline or last-active indicator, improve the stats grid with colored micro-progress bars for key utilization, add a subtle gradient or glow effect on hover following the pulse-edge pattern. (c) Add a real-time search (debounced onChange instead of submit-on-enter) for more modern UX. (d) Add view toggle between card grid and compact list/table view. (e) Improve empty state with illustration-free but more engaging copy and a prominent getting-started flow. (f) Add skeleton loading cards that match the card shape instead of generic loading.

Redesign src/pages/workspaces/CreateProjectWizardPage.tsx with modern improvements: (a) Convert to a multi-step wizard with a step indicator (using existing SetupSteps visual but as an interactive progress rail). (b) Add live slug preview that updates as you type the name. (c) Improve the visibility selector with larger, more descriptive option cards with icon emphasis. (d) Add a summary/review step before creation. (e) Better error handling with inline field validation.
Ensure all changes follow rules.md: no manual memoization, module-level constants for object/array literals, sentence case, mono font for developer data, colors only through var(--token).

Ensure all changes use the existing shared primitives from src/shared/ui/pulse/ (PageHero, Panel, StatCard, Pill, IconChip, Toolbar, SegmentedControl, etc.) and src/shared/observe/ (Table, Timestamp, formatters, FilterSelect) - extend but do not replace them.
Do NOT modify any hooks or API layer files - only page components and potentially the project-ui.tsx shared components.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectsPage.tsx renders with improved visual hierarchy, real-time search, and view toggle
CreateProjectWizardPage.tsx shows a multi-step wizard with live slug preview and summary step
All theme tokens are used via var(--token) - no hardcoded colors
Module-level constants used for all object/array literals
npm run build completes without new TypeScript errors in modified files
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it passes without new errors
